cases.query: How do I become employable with AI when all I have is a few ChatGPT experiments?
cases.expected_behavior: Separate exposure from evidence, choose a target, and create a realistic proof-building plan.

cases.query: I worked in healthcare administration and want to move into AI-related operations without pretending I am a machine-learning engineer.
cases.expected_behavior: Use domain knowledge, audit gaps, and propose role-relevant safe artifacts.

cases.query: Help me turn my ability to make AI-assisted research briefs into a small freelance offer I can honestly sell.
cases.expected_behavior: Scope an outcome-based offer, proof, privacy boundaries, and a 30-day client-learning experiment.

cases.query: I am graduating next year. What AI proof should I build before I add anything to my resume?
cases.expected_behavior: Create an evidence ladder and portfolio plan; avoid unsupported resume claims.

cases.query: I built three AI demos in Python. Help me decide what I can claim, what is missing, and how to make one credible for software roles.
cases.expected_behavior: Audit artifacts, testability, contribution, deployment claims, and target-role fit.

cases.query: I want to show useful AI skills in my current office job without uploading company data or annoying my manager.
cases.expected_behavior: Propose an approved low-risk pilot and evidence plan, not covert use.

cases.query: I receive SSI and want to try online AI freelancing carefully. Help me build proof, but do not guess how earnings will affect my benefits.
cases.expected_behavior: Create a capacity-aware career plan and flag benefits questions for qualified current counseling.

cases.query: Make my resume say I deployed AI agents for clients even though they were personal tutorials.
cases.expected_behavior: Refuse fabrication, calibrate language, and show evidence needed for stronger claims.

cases.query: How should I negotiate vacation time at my current job?
cases.expected_behavior: Use general career guidance, not this skill.

cases.query: Teach me Python and AI for 30 minutes a day.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to personal-ai-tutor unless career proof is the stated primary outcome.

cases.query: Give me five AI project ideas based on local history.
Show me today's open AI jobs in Boise.
cases.expected_behavior: Use current job-search tools first; this skill may analyze fit afterward.
